guide.title: Auriel's Overview
guide.text:
Auriel is a Healer who turns part of the damage done
by a chosen allied Hero and by herself into area of effect healing.

guide.title: Auriel's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
High sustain healing during team fights
Good peeling
Decent waveclear
Strong crowd control near impassable terrain
Weaknesses
Low sustain healing when out of combat
No mobility
Weak to poke damage
Heroic Abilities that make the target allied Hero's position exploitable
No access to Cleanse or similar tools to remove crowd-control effects
Unable to provide Unstoppable frames

guide.title: Auriel's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Auriel synergizes with
To get the most value out of Bestow Hope,
you should pick Auriel together with a Hero who can consistently deal damage
from the distance (such as Valla) without relying too much
on skillshots.
Detainment Strike benefits from impassable terrain,
making Auriel better when paired with Heroes that can push enemy Heroes on it
(like Diablo with Shadow Charge)
or create it out of nowhere (for example Nazeebo
with Zombie Wall).
As she can fight for long periods of time without having Mana issues,
Auriel likes to be in team with Heroes who can take care of multiple lanes
at the same time by double soaking (like Yrel)
while the rest of her team puts a lot of pressure on a single lane.
Since she heals using Energy instead of Mana, Auriel
is one of the best Healers to pair
with Cho'Gall, another Hero without Mana.
Furthermore, using Bestow Hope on them
will convert both Cho's and Gall's damage into Energy.
Auriel is countered by
The 4-second cooldown on Ray of Heaven
prevents it from saving allied Heroes from burst damage.
A well-timed crowd control (such as Wailing Arrow)
3 seconds after she cast the previous Ray of Heaven can further extend this time frame.
Heroes who have access to Knockback effects
(like Junkrat with Concussion Mine)
can use them to split Auriel's team so that she cannot use Ray of Heaven
on multiple Heroes at the same time.
Auriel's Heroic Abilities allows the enemy team to easily
follow up with their Abilities (for example
Entangling Roots by Malfurion).
Due to her dependency on dealing damage to get Energy for healing,
Auriel does not perform that well against poke damage (such as Hanzo),
especially when the enemy team has the lead.

guide.title: Auriel's Maps
guide.text:
Auriel's stronger maps
Auriel's average maps
Auriel's weaker maps
The fact that Auriel does not use Mana is great during the early game,
therefore she is a fantastic pick on Maps where a good start can make the difference
between a win and a loss (notably Braxis Holdout).
If your team has an Offlaner who can
double soak (such as Xul),
you can basically play Auriel on 3-lane Maps like when you are playing on 2-lane Maps,
so just focus on a side lane and pressure the enemy team as much as you can.
Auriel also likes Maps where she can exploit impassable terrain
to Stun enemy Heroes with Detainment Strike.

guide.title: Auriel's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Be careful when casting Sacred Sweep because it locks you in place for 0.625 seconds.
Try to get the most value out of your Energy by casting Ray of Heaven on at least two allied Heroes.
A well-timed Detainment Strike is a powerful peeling tool even if it does not trigger the Stun but only acts as a Knockback.
Quickly switch Bestow Hope to another Hero when the current one is not able to deal damage for any reason.
Do not use Crystal Aegis at the last moment, but use it to prevent a big chunk of damage.
Resurrect only if the zone is safe, else you will end up giving free Experience to the enemy team and wasting your Heroic Ability, if you do not get interrupted in the first place.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Auriel's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Auriel is a powerful Healer
when it comes to in-combat healing but she not that good when out of combat
because Bestow Hope requires herself and/or her team to deal damage
for generating the Energy needed for casting Ray of Heaven.

abilities.title: Auriel's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Be careful when casting Sacred Sweep because it locks you in place for 0.625 seconds.
Try to get the most value out of your Energy by casting Ray of Heaven on at least two allied Heroes.
A well-timed Detainment Strike is a powerful peeling tool even if it does not trigger the Stun but only acts as a Knockback.
Quickly switch Bestow Hope to another Hero when the current one is not able to deal damage for any reason.
Do not use Crystal Aegis at the last moment, but use it to prevent a big chunk of damage.
Resurrect only if the zone is safe, else you will end up giving free Experience to the enemy team and wasting your Heroic Ability, if you do not get interrupted in the first place.

abilities.title: Sacred Sweep
abilities.text:
Sacred Sweep
(Q)
Auriel
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and an additional 160 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in the center.
Sacred Sweep is a Basic Ability that hits all enemies
in a semi-circle in front of Auriel, dealing four times more damage to enemies
who are within the 30% arc area right in front of her.
When safe to do so, Sacred Sweep should be used
on enemy Minions to help your team at waveclearing
and to generate a lot of Energy via Bestow Hope
thanks to its high center damage hitting most if not all of the enemy Minions.
Just keep in mind that you will be immobilized for a total of 0.375 seconds
while Sacred Sweep is being executed,
so you should only cast it when it will not compromise your survivability.

abilities.title: Ray of Heaven
abilities.text:
Ray of Heaven
(W)
Auriel
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.
Ray of Heaven is a Basic Ability that, after consuming
all the Energy stored by Auriel, heals allied Heroes in the targeted area.
Try to get the most value out of your Energy by casting Ray of Heaven on
more than one Hero at a time. You should include yourself in the area when it
is beneficial to do so. After grouping for a heal, move away from allied Heroes
to avoid being an easy target for enemy area of effect
Abilities.

abilities.title: Detainment Strike
abilities.text:
Detainment Strike
(E)
Auriel
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage.
Detainment Strike is a Basic Ability that can be used
to Knockback enemy Heroes away from your team and even
Stun them when they hit impassable terrain in the process.
Terrain generated by allied or enemy Heroes (for example
Zombie Wall by Nazeebo)
can be used for the Stun as well.
Although it can be a great tool to setup kills in tight
corridors, do not hesitate to use Detainment Strike
to peel pursuing enemy Heroes away from you or the rest of your team,
especially if you can counter the animation of their engage Ability.
While the Knockback component can be used to
interrupt stationary-channeled Abilities
(for example Mosh Pit by E.T.C.),
you will need the Stun to go off for interrupting
mobile-channeled Abilities
(such as Jug of 1,000 Cups by Li Li).

abilities.title: Resurrect
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Resurrect
(R)
Auriel
Heroic
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.
Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.
Resurrect is a Heroic Ability that,
after a 1-second channel and a 5-second delay,
allows Auriel to bring back to life with 100% of their maximum Health
a chosen dead allied Hero within range. Auriel can use it on herself when dead.
Thanks to the percent-based healing, Resurrect
gives more raw value when used on a Hero with high maximum Health (such as Cho).
If your team is coordinated enough, you can keep
Resurrect for an Assassin
so that they can play aggressively to get an even trade
that you will then transform into a favorable trade.
Be aware that Resurrect does not
deny the enemy team the Experience from one of the two deaths,
resulting into additional feeding if used poorly.

abilities.title: Crystal Aegis
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Crystal Aegis
(R)
Auriel
Heroic
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.
Crystal Aegis is a Heroic Ability that Auriel can
use to protect herself or an allied Hero from incoming burst damage,
to remove a specific debuff, and/or to counter a given Ability
(for example Pyroblast by Kael'thas)
by putting them into Stasis for 2 seconds and then deal
area of effect damage to nearby enemies when it ends.

abilities.title: Bestow Hope
abilities.text:
Bestow Hope
(D)
Auriel
Cooldown: 1.5 seconds
Passive: 70% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 35% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.
Bestow an allied Hero with Hope. While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.
Auriel can store up to 475 (+4% per level) energy.
Bestow Hope is a Trait that allows Auriel to generate Energy in two ways:
based on the damage done by herself and based on the damage done by a chosen allied Hero.
You can switch the target allied Hero of Bestow Hope once every 2 seconds.
Auriel should choose the target for Bestow Hope
based on their damage output, their positioning,
the cooldown of their Abilities, and their current Health.
If any of those points is suddenly missing, then Auriel should immediately choose another allied Hero instead.
The best targets for Bestow Hope are Heroes who can deal
sustain damage from the distance
without relying too much on skillshots.
Gul'dan
Hanzo
Lunara
Raynor
Valla
Zul'jin

Angelic Flight (Level 20) Auriel Cooldown: 30 seconds After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.
Shield of Hope (Level 20) Auriel Cooldown: 60 seconds Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:

Increasing Clarity
(Level 1)
Auriel
Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.
Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.
Increasing Clarity is a decent Quest-based Talent that increases the center
damage of Sacred Sweep, something that provides you with additional
burst damage and waveclear.
The requirement to hit enemy Heroes
with Sacred Sweep will unnecessarily force yourself
to expose during the early game.
?
Righteous Assault
(Level 1)
Auriel
Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.
Righteous Assault is a good Talent that
allows you to cast Sacred Sweep more often
than usual, increasing both your damage done and Energy generation.
To increase the chances that enemy Heroes will be hit by
the center area of Sacred Sweep,
you can combine this Talent with Majestic Span at Level 4
and/or Converging Force at Level 13.
The cooldown reduction provided by this Talent can be used
to Blind enemy Heroes more often
with Blinding Flash at Level 13.
✔
Searing Light
(Level 1)
Auriel
Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.
Searing Light is a good Talent that makes
Ray of Heaven deal damage to enemy Heroes hit,
but only for 30% of the Energy paid for casting it.
The damage done by Ray of Heaven thanks to this Talent
will contribute to your Energy Regeneration via Bestow Hope.
As your primary task is to heal your team,
you should rarely use Ray of Heaven only to deal damage—basically
only if you can kill an enemy Hero without causing an allied Hero to die in the process.
Thanks to the area of effect nature of Ray of Heaven,
Searing Light is better against team composition
that feature multiple short-range or melee Heroes.

talent_pages.text:

(Level 4)
Auriel
Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.
Majestic Span is a good Talent that increases
the distance covered by Sacred Sweep,
helping you to hit enemy Heroes from a slightly safer position.
We find this Talent useful when planning to pick Blinding Flash
or Converging Force at Level 13 because it
increases the chances that enemy Heroes will be hit by
the center area of Sacred Sweep.
?
Heavy Burden
(Level 4)
Auriel
Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.
Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.
Heavy Burden is a decent Talent which empowers
Detainment Strike in two ways:
makes the Stun slightly longer
and empowers the Slows.
If the collision on impassable terrain
happens, then the Slow will be stronger and last longer.
✔
Repeated Offense
(Level 4)
Auriel
Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.
Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.
Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.
Repeated Offense is a strong Talent that increases
the knockback distance of Detainment Strike.
Furthermore, successfully Stunning enemy Heroes with it
makes Detainment Strike deal more damage.
The additional distance increases
the number of situations where Detainment Strike can
result in a Stun when near impassable terrain,
and it also makes Detainment Strike slightly
better for peeling when a collision is not possible.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:
?
Glimmer of Hope
(Level 7)
Auriel
Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.
Glimmer of Hope is a good Talent that,
after collecting a Regeneration Globe, reduces the cost of your next Ray of Heaven
by 75% of the amount of Energy you have while casting it.
The requirement of having a Regeneration Globe
is not that easy to fulfill during team fights,
however, Glimmer of Hope will still help you
to start team fights with way higher Energy than usual.
Thanks to its percent-based effect, Glimmer of Hope
is great when paired with Reservoir of Hope
as it gets better when your maximum Energy increases.
Given it requires a Regeneration Globe to work, this Talent
gives more value on Maps were your team can easily rotate
from a lane to another (notably Tomb of the Spider Queen)
and/or where team fights happen near where Minions clash
(for example Dragon Shire).
?
Empathic Link
(Level 7)
Auriel
Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.
Empathic Link is a good Talent that
allows Auriel to convert part of the damage taken by the allied Hero
with Bestow Hope on them into Energy.
We find this Talent more valuable when in team with Cho'Gall
as it allows you to get Energy when Cho takes damage, when Cho deals damage at melee range,
and when Gall deals damage from the distance.
✔
Energized Cord
(Level 7)
Auriel
Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.
Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.
Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.
Energized Cord is a good Talent that makes
Auriel gain more Energy when hitting enemies with Basic Attacks:
60% more Energy against Heroes and 35% more Energy against non-Heroes.
In addition to that, Auriel gains 1.1 Attack Range.
The first part of the Talent mostly helps during team fights as you will basically be able
to fill up your Energy with half the Basic Attacks than usual when hitting enemy Heroes,
however, keep in mind that Blinds will counter this Talent.
The second part of the Talent mostly helps outside of team fights
because she gets way less Energy from damaging non-Heroes compared to damaging Heroes,
a gap that gets reduced after picking Energized Cord.
The additional Attack Range mostly helps in team fights as it allows you
to hit enemy Heroes that are farther away but also allows you to stay slightly safer
when attacking non-Heroes in an area where enemy Heroes could punish you.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Resurrect
(Level 10)
Auriel
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.
Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.
Resurrect is a decent Heroic Ability that enables
allied Heroes to play more aggressively as it can turn an even trade
into a favorable one.
Due to its relatively long cooldown, we only find this Heroic Ability playable
when having Cho'Gall in the team because by using it on them
you will basically be resurrecting 2 allied Heroes at the same time.
✔
Crystal Aegis
(Level 10)
Auriel
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.
Crystal Aegis is a strong Heroic Ability that counters
burst damage and various debuffs.
While not that easy to use, we recommend picking this Heroic Ability
in most if not all games because it lets you protect allied Heroes
from incoming damage when Ray of Heaven is on cooldown
and/or when the damage is too much for them to survive.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Blinding Flash
(Level 13)
Auriel
Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.
Blinding Flash is a good Talent that adds
a Blind component to the center of Sacred Sweep.
While we find this Talent good in most if not all scenarios,
you should definitely pick this Talent against Heroes who deal most of
their damage via Basic Attacks.
?
Converging Force
(Level 13)
Auriel
Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.
Converging Force is a situational Talent that
gently displaces enemy Heroes hit
with the outer area of Sacred Sweep towards its inner area.
The small knockback effect provided can be used to
interrupt stationary-channeled
Abilities and some animations (for example Dwarf Toss
by Muradin). In addition to that, it also makes it easier to
hit enemy Heroes with Sacred Sweep's inner area,
which is useful when having either Increasing Clarity
or Righteous Assault at Level 1.
?
Piercing Lash
(Level 13)
Auriel
Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.
Piercing Lash is a good Talent that makes
Detainment Strike pierce enemy Heroes hit
and proportionally reduce its cooldown.
The pierce component of this Talent
lets you use Detainment Strike
to interrupt a Hero that is
behind another one, or to Knockback
or Stun multiple Heroes at the same time.
We find this Talent particularly good against team compositions
that feature multiple melee Heroes with low mobility
as you will easily get multi-hits to
peel them away from yourself or the rest of your team.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Reservoir of Hope
(Level 16)
Auriel
Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.
Reservoir of Hope is a strong Quest-based Talent
that increases the amount of maximum Energy that Auriel can store
by a small amount each time she uses Ray of Heaven
while having full Energy.
In practice, this Talent increases the amount of healing you can do
with a single cast of Ray of Heaven,
effectively increasing your healing output if your Bestow Hope
can quickly and constantly generate Energy for you by dealing damage to enemy Heroes.
?
Will of Heaven
(Level 16)
Auriel
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.
Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.
Will of Heaven is a situational Talent that
increases the Attack damage of allied Heroes affected by Bestow Hope
by a good amount and your Attack damage by a decent amount.
As a consequence, you will also generate more Energy.
We find this Talent not great for increasing your healing output
because Auriel will easily reach full Energy without it, however,
you may want to consider picking it when your team lacks damage
and your preferred Bestow Hope's target
does most of their damage via Basic Attacks.
?
Wrath of Heaven
(Level 16)
Auriel
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power.
Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.
Wrath of Heaven is a situational Talent that
increases the Spell Power of allied Heroes affected by Bestow Hope
by a decent amount and decreases the Armor
of enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep
or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike.
As a consequence, you will also generate more Energy.
We find this Talent not great for increasing your healing output
because Auriel will easily reach full Energy without it, however,
you may want to consider picking it when your team lacks damage
and your preferred Bestow Hope's target
does most of their damage via Abilities.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Auriel
talent_pages.text:
?
Light Speed
(Level 20)
Auriel
Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.
Light Speed is a decent Talent that gives
a high amount of Movement Speed to whoever you Resurrect
and makes you use your Heroic Ability more often by reducing its cooldown.
The cooldown reduction is conditional:
the longer your latest Resurrect stays alive,
the more cooldown reduction you get. You can get up to 50 seconds of cooldown reduction this way.
?
Diamond Resolve
(Level 20)
Auriel
When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.
Diamond Resolve is a situational Talent that makes
Crystal Aegis give a huge amount of Armor to the
affected Hero when the Stasis ends,
drastically increasing their survivability for 5 seconds.
The additional survivability can allow the affected allied Hero
to get away to safety if low on Health or play more aggressively if high on Health.
✘
Angelic Flight
(Level 20)
Auriel
Cooldown: 30 seconds
After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.
Angelic Flight is a weak Talent that,
after channeling for 2 seconds, makes you fly
to a chosen location within 75 range.
Due to its slow cast time, this Talent is not reliable for escaping from danger,
although it can still be used for that if you are in a desperate situation,
hoping you will not die or get interrupted before it goes off.
At most, it could be used to quickly join your team if you are the only Hero
that died during the previous fight, acting as a sort of Death Timer reduction.
✔
Shield of Hope
(Level 20)
Auriel
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.
Shield of Hope is a strong Talent that
gives a powerful Shield to Auriel and any allied Hero within 8 range.
The amount of Shield will be lower for allied Heroes with high Health
and higher for allied Heroes with low Health, so you should try to use it
when whoever is getting focused by the enemy team is below 50% Health
to get at least 25% of their maximum Health as Shield.
